test_name: H6 — Card carousel + transaction bottom sheet (Card Details showcase)

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: H6 — Card carousel + transaction bottom sheet (Card Details showcase)
proposed_scenarios.description: This scenario verifies the user's ability to log in, navigate to the cards section, interact with the card carousel, and view transaction details via a bottom sheet, including opening and closing transaction details.
proposed_scenarios.workflow_narrative: The user launches the application, bypasses version check, and logs in using provided credentials. After successfully authenticating with an OTP and dismissing initial popups (legal, reminder, notifications), the user lands on the dashboard. They then navigate to the 'Cards' tab, interact with the card carousel by swiping, and tap on a transaction to view its details in a bottom sheet. Finally, they close the transaction detail sheet, open another transaction's details, and close it.
appium_implementation_guidance: Use WebDriverWait for element presence and visibility before interaction.
For OTP, ensure the environment variable MOBILE_OTP is set at runtime.
Implement explicit waits for popups to appear before attempting to dismiss them.
For swipe actions, consider using `driver.swipe` or `TouchAction` with appropriate start/end coordinates and duration to simulate a left swipe.
Verify text content for dashboard greetings and transaction details using `element.text` assertions.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify critical card and transaction viewing functionality post-login.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a cardholder, I want to securely log in, view my card details, and inspect individual transactions so that I can manage my finances effectively.
